lines.text: A pink diamond sold for $71 million.
lines.say: A pink diamond sold for seventy-one million dollars.

lines.text: De Beers mined the rough stone in Africa in 1999.
lines.say: De Beers mined the rough stone in Africa in nineteen ninety-nine.

lines.text: It weighed 132.5 carats before anyone cut it.
lines.say: It weighed one hundred thirty-two and a half carats before anyone cut it.

lines.text: Two years of cutting and polishing made it a 59.6-carat oval.
lines.say: Two years of cutting and polishing made it an oval of fifty-nine point six carats.

lines.text: The Gemological Institute of America had never graded
a larger internally flawless, vivid pink diamond.
On April 4, 2017, Sotheby's offered it in Hong Kong.
lines.say: On the fourth of April, twenty seventeen, Sotheby's offered it in Hong Kong.

lines.text: The chairman of Chow Tai Fook, a Hong Kong jewelry company,
lines.say: The chairman of Chow Tie Fook, a Hong Kong jewelry company,

lines.text: It paid $71.2 million, the most ever for a diamond at auction.
lines.say: It paid seventy-one point two million dollars, the most ever for a diamond at auction.

lines.text: It became the CTF Pink Star, in memory of the company's founder.
lines.say: It became the C T F Pink Star, in memory of the company's founder.

post.caption: A pink diamond that began as a 132.5-carat rough stone sold for $71.2 million in Hong Kong, the most ever paid for a diamond at auction.
